entries.text: Overview page quality upgrade shipped (46f2f25, display-only). Biggest find: the page showed three different gold prices with no provenance — strip Yahoo GC=F 4399.70 vs engine MT5 XAUUSD 4341.28, $58.42 apart side by side. Prices now carry source + age and flag strip/engine divergence >0.25% (Gold +1.346% flagged; BTC and SPX inside tolerance). Charts gained a to-scale level rail drawing the engine's own TGT/ENTRY/STOP/pivots/EMA200 with risk-reward bands, plus EMA200+BB studies, lazy build/destroy (layout-1 was running 3 live iframes to show 1), layout-driven height, and persisted timeframe. Separately: the dashboard hardcoded the confidence gate as 65 in five places while the live gate is 70, so every displayed gap was 5pt short — Gold read 10pt when it was 15pt. Gate now read from /api/strategy-settings.

FVG detection live (66f66f8). Server restarted to load GET /api/fvg — killed the server PID only, not the tree; both MT5 bridge processes survived and bridge A reconnected in 18s. mt5CandleCache is in-memory so FVG read "no fresh MT5 bars" for the first 240s until the bridge's first candle push, exactly as designed rather than falling back to Yahoo. First live read: BTC 11 unfilled daily zones with a bearish h4 gap 64822-64928 formed this bar and price sitting inside it; GOLD 8 daily with bearish 4353-4424 at 41% filled; SPX 12 daily, all bullish below price. FVG has no vote in confidence, the gate or sizing — unmeasured geometry stays observability-only until walk-forward tested. Flag: two local mt5_bridge.py --auto processes running (PIDs 9956, 3020) though only account A reports.

CORRECTION to the earlier note today: there is no duplicate MT5 bridge. The two python PIDs matching mt5_bridge.py --auto are a PATH shim plus the uv CPython 3.11 child it re-execs — the child's parent IS the shim, identical start time, shim at 0s CPU. One bridge, tag A, confirmed by /api/risk-status listing a single account and ensure_running reporting "this machine owns tag(s) A / BRIDGE A: reporting". Nothing was killed. Second correction: killing only the server PID (no /T) did NOT leave the bridge untouched as the restart note claimed — the bridge exited and relaunched one second after the server kill (fresh startup banner in bridge_log_A.txt at 07:15:06 local). A PID existence check taken seconds after the kill showed it alive and was misleading. Verify bridge restarts by the log banner and CreationDate, not a PID check.

VPS parity restored + FVG interpretation layer shipped (bcca2b2). VPS now has server/fvg.js, fvg.test.js (44/44 passing ON the VPS), a surgically patched index.js and a byte-identical dashboard; /api/fvg serves there instead of returning "Not logged in". index.js was PATCHED not copied — VPS HEAD ba1077b does not exist in the laptop repo, so a wholesale copy would have destroyed VPS-only work. Restart done via the SmartEntryServer scheduled task, which leaves SmartEntryBridgeA untouched; VPS bridge A stayed connected and unhalted throughout. Interpretation: zones are now read against the live entry/stop/target — verdicts STOP INSIDE A GAP (outranks all, it is the one that costs money), ENTRY INTO OPPOSING ZONE, PATH OBSTRUCTED, PATH CLEAR; WAIT assets get a landscape description instead. Everything carries measured:false and feeds nothing.

Geometry measured against a matched control (1ae053f). FVG HAS NO EDGE: ~6800 samples, daily 10y -0.137R vs control -0.001R = 6.9pp worse than random, hourly no difference. The dashboard panel now labels itself measured-no-edge instead of implying the zones are tradeable; it stays as context only. CRT is ahead of its control in ALL SIX asset/timeframe cells (daily +0.194R, hourly +0.163R, ~6800 trades) — the only real candidate so far, but absolute expectancy is just +0.089R/trade and spread+commission of 0.05-0.15R could erase it, so it needs a walk-forward WITH COSTS before it gets a vote. AMD unmeasurable: 33 trades pooled, and the real blocker is that mt5_bridge.py sends no timestamps, so AMD is bar-window shaped and carries sessionAligned:false. Harness self-validates — pooled daily control landed at exactly 50.0% win / -0.001R.

Gate verdict layer live on BOTH boxes (5887961). GET /api/rejection-evidence + MCP get_rejection_evidence grade every gate: EARNING ITS KEEP / COSTING MONEY / NO MEASURABLE COST / TOO FEW TO JUDGE. The ledger, scorer and shadow learning already existed and run nightly — only the verdict was missing. Two discoveries: (1) the boxes keep SEPARATE ledgers and the VPS is 4x richer (86 resolved MIN_RR episodes vs 22 local, +22.47R vs +7.14R) because it runs continuously, so always query the VPS for gate questions; (2) the real finding is a DIRECTION SPLIT — RANGE_TRADE_LONG 59W/11L and BUY_OVERSOLD 8W/0L but RANGE_TRADE_SHORT 0W/8L, so MIN_RR rejecting longs costs money while rejecting shorts saves it. Any experiment must be per-direction, never a global MIN_RR move. Contradicts the 4-year walk-forward; walk-forward wins and nothing moved. Non-invasive verified: index.js diff is 24 lines, all additions, none touching gate logic. CLAUDE.md and REJECTION-LEDGER-SPEC.md updated. Next gap: 6 of 10 gates still produce no rows, including COHORT_FLOOR.

AI Brain rebuilt as a control surface (3cb5cea), live on both boxes. Evidence board shows 6 claims with verdict/evidence/caveat/what-would-change-the-answer joined to live gate verdicts; catalogue shows 44 skills, 6 agents, 23 MCP tools (2 flagged TRADES); 7 guardrails split ENFORCED IN CODE vs PROCEDURAL. Gate gap CLOSED with a diagnosis not a fix: all 10 gates are correctly wired. ENTRY_RSI is disarmed by config (minEntryRsi 0), COHORT_FLOOR only records when a setup clears the global gate first and nothing gets near 70, and the bridge gates fire only on a real trade attempt. The funnel dies at CONFIDENCE (killed 5 / passed 1). Correction: bridge gates are silent on the LAPTOP, not universally — the VPS has MAX_POSITIONS evidence because it is the box that trades. Also fixed the MCP banner claiming 19 tools when 23 are registered. All additive: index.js 53 lines, zero deletions, zero gate-related lines; self-learning untouched, nothing deleted, backups taken on the VPS before every replace.

CRT walk-forward WITH COSTS complete (7cb17de), deployed both boxes. 15/15 sequential out-of-sample folds positive gross across 10 years and 3 assets. Break-even round-trip cost: GOLD $2.95 (13.0% of avg bar range, 5/5 folds still positive at 10% cost), SPX 3.68 index points (8.2%, 3/5), BTC $29.91 (2.1%, 0/5). Real spreads: XAUUSD $0.20-0.50 and SP500 0.4-1.0 points both clear comfortably; BTC's break-even is 0.047% of price which sits inside ordinary crypto CFD spreads, and a ~1700pt BTCUSD spread is on record — BTC is dead. Pooled 1135 trades, 74.8% win, +0.10R gross, +0.04R at 5% cost. Caught a bug in my own harness first: the pooled sweep averaged bar ranges across BTC/Gold/SPX and charged one price to all three, reporting -0.1377R at 2% cost when the correct per-asset charge gives +0.0775R — the sign was wrong. STILL NOT WIRED IN: this is Yahoo data so Gold is GC=F futures, not the XAUUSD spot the engine trades, and that basis has already produced one phantom signal here. Next step recorded in the evidence register: re-measure on MT5 XAUUSD bars and price against the broker's real spread. Evidence board on both boxes now shows the updated CRT claim. VPS bridge reconnected 40s after restart, not halted.

CRT transfer test complete (5788efe), deployed both boxes. THE YAHOO PROXY OVERSTATED GOLD BY ~3x. Measured on the instrument the engine actually trades via new local-only GET /api/mt5/candles/raw: GOLD D1 broker XAUUSD +0.097R with break-even $6.19 from 52 patterns, versus Yahoo GC=F +0.269R with break-even $14.10 from only 30 patterns. GC=F finding 30 patterns where XAUUSD finds 52 on the same window means the detector sees different structure on the two series — every Gold number measured on GC=F should now be treated as describing a different instrument. Gold still clears ($6.19 break-even against a $0.20-0.50 spread) but three times less comfortably than the walk-forward implied. SPX transfers cleanly and SPX H1 on broker bars is now the strongest single cell in the project: +0.156R, break-even 13.2% of bar range. BTC confirmed dead — D1 a thin +0.047R, H1 negative on both series. Also fixed a labelling defect in my own harness that flagged Gold H1 as a failure when the traded instrument was the profitable side. Still not wired in: the MT5 sample is 1-2 years and unfolded because the bridge caches 300 daily bars; the unlock is raising BAR_COUNT_BY_TIMEFRAME, but the candle payload already hit a 413 at ~240kb. Raw route verified 403 from outside and 200 locally; both bridges connected, neither halted.

EMA200 accuracy fix shipped both boxes (e432acc). emaSeries seeded on closes[0] with too little history: 23.5% of the value was one old close at 145 bars (Yahoo default), 12.9% at 205, 5.0% at 300. Gold's EMA200 was $185 out on the Yahoo path, $111 on GC=F, $21 on MT5, and the price-vs-EMA200 trend call disagreed with converged on 1.3-2.3% of days. I first tried SMA seeding and IT WAS WORSE — at 300 bars Gold error went +21 to -50 and BTC +254 to +672, because period 200 with 300 bars leaves only 100 recursion steps so 37% of the answer is an average of old closes. I had already restarted the local server on that bad build; verification against a converged reference caught it and it was reverted in the same session. The real fix is bar count: SMA seed only at >=3x period, DAILY_RANGE 210d/300d -> 900d, BAR_COUNT_BY_TIMEFRAME d1 300 -> 600. The 413 that shaped the old counts is stale (101kb dump vs a 2mb limit). KEY FINDING: gate 70 was validated on a 400-bar replay while production ran 300 — blessed on a different indicator than the one trading; at the production window it is 4/5 not 5/5. With the corrected build the replay is unchanged at 5/5 ROBUST and 70 is still the only 5/5 gate. PENDING: the 600-bar change only takes effect on a BRIDGE restart, not done on either box — VPS has 3 open positions (BTCUSD BUY, XAUUSD SELL, XAUUSD BUY) so that needs a decision; laptop bridge needs elevation.

Learning Growth tracker shipped both boxes (222f2f9). Tracks EVIDENCE accumulation rather than P&L, because the existing Performance growth tracker is blank on one closed fill and will stay blank for months. Laptop: 30 resolved, 89 pending, 3/4 setups usable, 7.5/day STEADY. VPS: 96 resolved, 147 pending, 4/4 usable, 24/day — the always-on box learns 3x faster. Three of four setups are already past the 5-episode threshold the live engine cannot reach on real fills, which is the whole argument for the shadow ledger. Backfilled from ledger timestamps so it draws a real 4-day curve. Also recorded a monitoring trap: for ~60s after a server restart /api/mt5/positions returns 0 open because that cache is bridge-populated — it looks exactly like every trade closing. Verified by polling: all 3 VPS positions unchanged throughout. AI EMPLOYEE FINDING: scheduled AI jobs have no accountability. 'SmartEntry - Weekly Algo Review' last ran today 10:00 and returned result 1 (FAILURE) and nothing surfaced it; improvement_reports/ holds exactly one report, from 2026-08-07. The AI employee runs, sometimes fails silently, and nobody can see whether its output was ever read or acted on.

AI Employee accountability shipped both boxes (f98235b, 8e59d48). server/ai_work_ledger.js + GET /api/ai-work + AI Brain panel + tasks/ai_decide.cjs give every scheduled AI job a verdict — FAILING / STALE / OUTPUT IGNORED / NO COMPLETION MARKER / HEALTHY — and surface every PROPOSED FIX with its review status. Laptop: 3 unreviewed proposals, all pointing at the same /api/trade-opened validation gap. VPS: 2 unreviewed. Decisions recorded by CLI append-only, never HTTP, so the server keeps no write path. IT IMMEDIATELY FOUND A SYSTEMIC BUG: claude is claude.cmd, and a .CMD run from a .BAT without `call` never returns — 19 invocations across 17 files, 16 with dead code after them. improve_algo.bat lost 25 lines including its entire apply-the-fix flow; daily_check.bat's SECOND claude call had never run at all; no script in this project had EVER written its [exit N] completion marker, which is why the ledger could not confirm a single completed run. Fixed uniformly with `call` — 19 insertions, 19 deletions, only claude lines touched, re-audit clean, VPS bats redeployed. Both boxes healthy, bridges connected, VPS still 3 positions open and untouched.

AI employee made professional (2d7f114), deployed both boxes. The work ledger showed its output went unread; this fixes the other half — it was also working UNBRIEFED. Evidence: the weekly review proposed validating sig.signal in /api/trade-opened with sound code-cited reasoning, and the fix was ALREADY IMPLEMENTED more thoroughly than it asked for. Not wrong, uninformed. It also emitted the same finding three times across two files. tasks/ai_brief.cjs now assembles a briefing from what the project already records: proposals already decided with the reviewer's note (do not repeat), its own open proposals (reference the id, do not restate), everything already measured with what would change the answer, the live config read from file rather than assumed, and how much evidence exists per setup. Plus house rules that are the actual professionalism: one finding not five, cite file:line, mark PROPOSED FIX: so the ledger tracks it, say what would change your mind, and if the honest answer is "not enough data" that IS the deliverable — this project has one closed fill and an agent inventing a conclusion from it does more damage than one saying nothing. Wired into auto_daily.bat and auto_weekly.bat, regenerated every run, generator verified to run before the claude call. Assessment of the 3 open proposals also completed: 2 implemented, 1 duplicate ignored, 0 unreviewed locally. Nothing deleted, no gate touched, VPS still 3 positions open and untouched.

Per-direction MIN_RR measured and REJECTED (6c29972), deployed both boxes. The ledger's strongest finding — MIN_RR wrong on longs only (RANGE_TRADE_LONG 59W/11L, BUY_OVERSOLD 8W/0L, RANGE_TRADE_SHORT 0W/8L) — did not survive walk-forward. Best candidate 1.35 long / 1.50 short shows +0.158R/trade and +8 trades overall, but 109% of that gain is ONE fold: folds 1 and 5 are worse, fold 3 is a rounding error, better in only 3/5. 1.25/1.50 improves in just 2/5. Shorts alone move nothing. VERDICT NOT PROVEN — the bar stays 1.5 both ways, nothing changed live. This is the SECOND time the paper ledger has pointed hard at MIN_RR and the second time folds declined; paper rejections have no spread, no slippage, entries never filled and a fixed horizon, so they systematically flatter the setups a constraint threw away. The ledger is a screen, not a jury. Also caught a bug in my own verdict logic first: it counted folds where the CANDIDATE was positive and reported 5/5, but the baseline is positive in 5/5 too — that measures whether the strategy makes money, not whether the change helped. Now compares per-fold deltas and flags when one fold supplies over 60% of the movement. New env MTF_MIN_RR_LONG/SHORT patch the replay sandbox only; server/index.js untouched. Both boxes healthy, VPS still 3 positions open and untouched.

JARVIS page rebuilt (5583411), deployed both boxes. The page that IS the assistant listed zero of its own capabilities — grep found "skill" 0 times, "agent" 0 times, "engineer" 0 times in the entire file, while 44 skills, 6 agents and 23 MCP tools sat on disk discoverable only if you already knew the name. Added a CAPABILITIES panel served by /api/ai-registry (same endpoint the AI Brain tab uses, so they cannot drift): SKILLS/AGENTS/TOOLS tabs, 44·6·23 counter, every tool tagged read-only/writes/TRADES with the two that can open a position in red. Clicking LOADS the prompt and does NOT send — a mis-click that fires /execute is not a UI worth shipping; verified 0 messages sent on click. /engineer promoted to its own control since it is the flagship parallel-agent capability and was indistinguishable from 43 alphabetical siblings. VISUAL: removed filter:hue-rotate(±30deg) which was animating on THREE layers over 22s — the page's colours were never the same twice and purple swung through blue and magenta each cycle, which on a terminal where green and red carry meaning is a real defect, not taste. Background alphas roughly halved so the glow is scenery behind panels rather than the substrate; palette deepened; --muted lifted from #4a6080 to #5b7096 because the old value failed contrast on the small uppercase labels that make up most of the sidebar; panels given a 1px top highlight and drop shadow for depth. All 18 removed lines are values replaced in place — no markup, function or feature deleted.

VPS parity checker built (6cb2606). Today the VPS took SEVEN hand-written surgical patches to server/index.js and ended with NINE .bak files, because its git history carries commits this repo has never seen — and nothing verified the result. node tasks/vps_parity.cjs now answers the one question hand-patching cannot: do both boxes run the same engine? Compares 11 engine functions (brace-matched from source the same way the replay does), 7 behavioural constants, the route surface and 16 tracked files, with line endings normalised and strategy_settings.json excluded because it is per-machine by design. One file with a --probe flag runs on BOTH sides so the methodology cannot differ. Exit 2 on divergence. FIRST RUN: ENGINES AGREE — 11/11 functions, 7/7 constants, 86/86 routes identical, so the boxes do produce the same signal from the same bars and that is now measured rather than assumed. It also found server/cohort_table.js ABSENT on the VPS — not a breakage since the VPS index.js does not require it either, but it means the VPS has NO dead-cohort audit and it is the box that trades continuously; it never reports which cohorts cannot reach the gate. Deploying that needs the file plus a require patch and was not done. Also shipped earlier this round: JARVIS logo redrawn (11 elements and 4 animations to 5 shapes and 1 motion, hexagonal aperture and J monogram legible at 52px where the old radial-gradient core was a blob), hero mark kept busy for its own 400px size with its CSS restored after a class audit caught the collateral, and the background replaced from an O(n^2) 190-node particle network doing ~18000 distance checks per frame with an O(n) market grid, sweep and drifting tape ticks.

DATA FEEDING improved (4452bef), deployed both boxes. Found the real weakness: mt5BarsFor judged freshness ONLY on receivedAt — the moment the POST landed — and never looked at the bars. Zero bar-timestamp references existed anywhere in server/index.js. So a wedged MT5 terminal handing the bridge a stale array would keep every health check green while the engine priced signals off old bars forever; push freshness is not data freshness and without timestamps the difference is invisible. Fix: mt5_bridge.py now sends `times` (bar open times, unix seconds) and judgeBarFreshness checks the NEWEST bar against a per-timeframe limit — d1 4 days, h4 16h, h1 5h, two periods of slack so a forming bar and weekend gaps do not read as a fault. A stale daily series falls back to Yahoo with a rate-limited warning printing both push age and data age. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE and that was the load-bearing part: the bridge cannot restart right now (3 positions open, safe_bridge_restart correctly refusing), so requiring timestamps would have taken the live feed down to fix a diagnostic. Absent timestamps report UNVERIFIED rather than passing silently — /api/mt5/candles exposes staleDetection so "we cannot detect staleness" is a visible state. Verified: 8 boundary cases pass plus the no-timestamps compatibility case; live, the pre-timestamp bridge pushed its 300 bars, source returned to mt5, endpoint read UNVERIFIED. Detection goes ACTIVE on the next bridge restart, which also picks up d1 300->600. Also unblocks AMD (real session boundaries were its recorded falsifier). VPS took surgical patch #8 and vps_parity.cjs then confirmed 11/11 engine functions, 7/7 constants and 86/86 routes still identical — the parity tool paying for itself one commit after being built. Both bridges connected, VPS still 3 positions open and untouched.
